execution_contract.important: The prompt-delivery audit must consume the actual prompt argument captured from each child dispatch, not merely a separately regenerated prompt. The JSON-output validator must consume the raw response returned by the child.

evals.name: Discovery prompt matches its template exactly
assertions: Capture the exact prompt argument used for each Discovery dispatch.
Render prompts/discovery-reviewer.md with the same values used for dispatch.
validate_prompt.py reports byte-for-byte equality.
Required headings and section order match the template.
No unresolved placeholders remain.

evals.name: Verification prompt matches its template exactly
assertions: Capture the exact prompt argument used for Verification dispatch.
Render prompts/verification-reviewer.md with the same candidate/context values.
validate_prompt.py reports byte-for-byte equality.
Verification-specific candidate sections and output format are present.
No Discovery-only prompt is sent to Verification.

evals.name: Batch prompt audit covers every dispatched reviewer
assertions: Create a dispatch audit manifest with every expected Discovery Reviewer and the required Verification Reviewer.
Each record identifies its exact model route, dispatch ID, role, template, values, captured prompt argument, capture method, and fresh-context evidence.
validate_dispatch_prompts.py succeeds only when all prompt arguments match their role templates.

evals.name: Actual prompt capture is required
assertions: A dispatch record with capture_method unavailable is rejected.
A generated prompt file that was not tied to the actual dispatch argument is not accepted as proof of delivery.
Overall review reports prompt delivery as unverified and cannot be COMPLETE.

evals.name: Discovery prompt preserves Markdown formatting
assertions: Flattening headings, paragraphs, lists, or fenced blocks into one line causes validation failure.
Reordering required headings causes validation failure.
Removing a required section causes validation failure.

evals.name: Verification prompt preserves Markdown formatting
assertions: Flattening or removing Verification sections causes validation failure.
The Verification template must include candidate findings, candidate recommendations, existing validation evidence, verification methods, and output format.

evals.name: Prompt placeholder completeness
assertions: Every required placeholder has a value.
No unresolved placeholder token remains after rendering.
Inserted values preserve multiline text and are not evaluated as template syntax.

evals.name: No extra prompt prefix or suffix
assertions: A generic preamble, controller narration, or appended unrelated instructions not present in the template causes exact comparison failure.
A path-only instruction to read a template is rejected.

evals.name: Correct role-template mapping
assertions: Discovery role must use discovery-reviewer.md.
Verification role must use verification-reviewer.md.
A role/template mismatch fails both individual and batch validation.

evals.name: Prompt output contract matches role
assertions: Discovery prompt contains the Discovery JSON output shape and field names.
Verification prompt contains finding_assessments and recommendation_assessments.
The sent prompt includes the exact output section from the current template.

evals.name: Prompt audit detects truncation
assertions: A prompt truncated at any section fails exact template comparison.
A truncated output contract cannot be treated as a valid dispatched prompt.

evals.name: Prompt audit detects line-ending and newline changes
assertions: Changing LF to CRLF, removing the final newline, or collapsing blank lines is detected by exact byte comparison.
The first differing line is included in the validation report.

evals.name: Prompt dispatch payload and capture agree
assertions: The captured prompt argument must be the actual string passed to the host's child-dispatch mechanism.
A pre-dispatch expected prompt that differs from the actual argument fails.
Capture provenance is dispatch_argument_capture or exact_argument_variable.

evals.name: Prompt dispatch reviewer inventory is complete
assertions: Missing Discovery dispatch IDs are detected.
Unexpected or duplicate reviewer IDs are detected.
Exactly one Verification dispatch is required when candidates exist and none is allowed when Verification is explicitly not required.

evals.name: Prompt audit self-tests pass
assertions: Positive Discovery and Verification prompt cases pass.
Flattened, truncated, wrong-role, and mismatched prompt cases fail.
Dispatch-manifest positive and negative cases behave as expected.

evals.name: Raw reviewer JSON is parsed mechanically
assertions: The raw child response is saved without manual transcription.
JSON syntax is parsed by validate_review_output.py.
Markdown fences, leading prose, trailing prose, duplicate JSON keys, and malformed JSON are rejected.

evals.name: Discovery output matches Discovery schema
assertions: Every Discovery response is validated against discovery-result.schema.json.
Missing required fields, extra fields, wrong types, invalid enums, malformed IDs, and invalid check records are rejected.

evals.name: Verification output matches Verification schema
assertions: Every Verification response is validated against verification-result.schema.json.
Missing fields, extra fields, invalid verdicts, and malformed candidate IDs are rejected.

evals.name: Verification candidate coverage is exact
assertions: Controller supplies the expected Finding and Recommendation ID manifest.
Missing candidate IDs are detected.
Duplicate candidate IDs are detected.
Unexpected candidate IDs are detected.
Each expected candidate has exactly one assessment.

evals.name: Finding verdict evidence constraints
assertions: confirmed and rejected verdicts require evidence.
Every assessment requires non-empty rationale.
uncertain and not_verifiable remain valid when explained.

evals.name: Discovery local candidate IDs are unique
assertions: Finding local IDs use the F- prefix.
Recommendation local IDs use the R- prefix.
Duplicate local IDs are rejected.

evals.name: Validation command records are internally consistent
assertions: Every executed check records purpose, command, status, exit code, scope, output, artifacts, and side effects.
A passed check requires exit code zero.
A failed check requires a non-zero exit code.
checks_not_run records a reason rather than pretending execution occurred.

evals.name: Discovery can execute focused tests
assertions: Reviewer may run the narrowest relevant existing test.
Exact command, exit code, output, assertion scope, and side effects are recorded.
No source or permanent test files are modified.
evals.validator: reviewer check log and output validator

evals.name: Discovery can execute a temporary reproducer
assertions: Reviewer may create a temporary reproducer outside the project tree.
The reproducer can compile/execute against project code without changing project sources.
Artifacts are isolated and recorded.
evals.validator: reviewer check log and output validator

evals.name: Verification can independently reproduce a candidate
assertions: Verification may run focused tests or a temporary reproducer for a supplied candidate.
It does not rely on Discovery's test conclusion as proof.
It does not repeat broad test suites without a concrete reason.
evals.validator: verification check log and output validator

evals.name: Test command side effects are inspected
assertions: Commands and invoked scripts are inspected before execution.
Tests that mutate production/shared services, persistent data, project source, configuration, dependencies, or VCS state are not run without required authorization.
Unsafe checks are recorded as not run with a specific reason.

evals.name: Tests may generate disposable artifacts
assertions: Temporary build/reproducer artifacts may be written to unique temporary/disposable paths.
Existing artifacts are not overwritten or broadly deleted.
Shared mutable test resources are not used concurrently without isolation.

evals.name: No blanket ban on shell or test commands
assertions: The workflow does not prohibit all shell commands, scripts, tests, or builds.
Reviewers can use available command tools within the stated safety boundary.
Lack of a per-child permission parameter is not a dispatch blocker.

evals.name: Baseline diff is primary review evidence
assertions: Controller supplies baseline/change diff and a changed-file inventory.
Discovery explicitly inspects the diff before current files.
Current files alone are not presented as a substitute for the baseline diff.
evals.validator: review input package and reviewer output

evals.name: Untracked and deleted files are represented
assertions: Untracked file content is included explicitly when the VCS diff omits it.
Deleted and renamed files are represented in scope.
Missing baseline evidence is disclosed and attribution remains unknown.

evals.name: Fresh contexts per model
assertions: A new independent context is created for each requested model route.
Discovery reviewers receive the same logical input.
Discovery outputs are not shared across reviewers.

evals.name: Exact model route or explicit failure
assertions: The exact requested route is selected when supported.
Unavailable routes are not silently substituted.
Host-accepted identity is reported only when observable.

evals.name: Verification is a separate fresh context
assertions: A separate Verification context is created when candidates exist.
The parent session's model is used when selectable.
Verification does not receive Discovery dialogue or parent private reasoning.

evals.name: No-candidate path is valid
assertions: When all Discovery reviewers complete scope and return no candidates, Verification is skipped.
The report states the reviewed scope and zero candidates.
Empty or invalid Discovery output is not treated as a clean review.

evals.name: Unique finding survives consolidation
assertions: A finding identified by one model is retained for Verification.
Source reviewer/local IDs and evidence are preserved.
Majority voting is not used.

evals.name: Duplicate candidates merge by root cause
assertions: Only same-root-cause findings or materially identical recommendations merge.
Distinct locations and independent evidence are preserved.
Same file or symptom alone does not prove duplication.

evals.name: Recommendation is not a defect
assertions: Recommendations describe a current approach and feasible alternative.
Benefits, trade-offs, and project fit are explicit.
Recommendations have no Bug Severity.

evals.name: Finding requires concrete impact
assertions: Finding has location, code evidence, reachable trigger, violated requirement/invariant or material quality weakness, and impact.
Style preferences and unsupported speculation are excluded.

evals.name: Tests are interpreted within actual scope
assertions: Report identifies the test's assertions and exercised path.
A passing narrow test is not treated as proof of unrelated behavior.
Failure attribution is established rather than assumed.

evals.name: Historical issue attribution is separate
assertions: Baseline comparison determines introduced/pre-existing/unknown where possible.
A pre-existing issue can still be a confirmed defect relevant to changed behavior.
No unsupported attribution is made.

evals.name: Malformed reviewer output remains invalid
assertions: One format-only repair is allowed.
The original raw response is retained.
A second invalid response remains invalid and is not counted as zero findings.
evals.validator: raw output archive and output validator

evals.name: PARTIAL reflects concrete completeness gaps
assertions: Unverified actual prompt delivery, invalid reviewer JSON, missing baseline coverage, missing candidate verdicts, or material blocked validation can cause PARTIAL.
The report names each reason.
Non-essential unrun tests alone do not force PARTIAL.

evals.name: BLOCKED is not caused by missing permission argument
assertions: A missing per-child permission parameter alone does not block reviewer dispatch.
Reviewer command execution is governed by the validation safety boundary and host capabilities.

evals.name: Workspace and VCS state are preserved
assertions: No reviewed source, permanent tests/configuration/dependencies, generated project assets, or VCS state is changed.
Only disposable temporary artifacts may be created by checks.
Observed side effects are recorded.

evals.name: Convergent review without endless reruns
assertions: Do not repeat the whole discovery review after every validation action.
Targeted re-checks address specific uncertain candidates or new evidence.
Previously established findings are not repeatedly re-reported without new evidence.
